title: Settings scroll fade — blend into its own background

steps.path: The scrolling edge beneath the title
steps.hint: Scroll inside each Settings drawer to see the fade; scroll outside it to reach the next version. Try Meadow Mist, Halftone and a solid theme using the theme buttons.
steps.headline: Should the content fade into the actual background instead of painting a flat strip?
steps.risk: Review-only Settings comparison. The 20% tapered title line is held constant here, not approved as a final endpoint. The shared dialogs and other scrolling surfaces need their own checks before this can become an app-wide treatment.

variants.label: Today: painted strip
variants.summary: The current scroll fade overlays a solid panel colour across the full width.
variants.risk: On translucent themes the strip does not match the actual background behind it.

variants.label: Fade the content
variants.summary: No painted colour. Scrolling content fades against the real drawer background, and the effect tapers toward the sides.
variants.risk: At the far sides, some content stays visible; check that this reads naturally while scrolling.
